narrative.overview: AgenticRAG feels like a serious desktop instrument: calm enough for sustained research, direct enough for debugging, and familiar to users of LM Studio and the ChatGPT desktop app. Conversation is the center of gravity; model, corpus, capability, and trace state stay one interaction away without competing with it.
keyCharacteristics: Dense enough for a developer; ordered enough for a later nontechnical layer.
Flat neutral surfaces with one scarce honey-amber signal.
LM Studio, ChatGPT desktop, and Linear as interaction references—not visual copies.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber occupies less than ten percent of a screen and marks the primary action, current focus, or one critical state—never decoration.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Language Rule
rules.body: No success, warning, connection, or failure state relies on color alone.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Conversation and explanation stay in sentence case; uppercase is restricted to compact operational labels.

rules.name: The Surface Truth Rule
rules.body: A panel earns separation through hierarchy and state, never through decorative floating-card shadows.

dos: Do keep conversation as the dominant workspace and cap explanatory prose near 75ch.
Do derive every capability and readiness signal from the backend response.
Do pair status color with a label, icon, or both.
donts: Don't use sci-fi terminal styling or gamer neon.
Don't compose the screen as a generic SaaS card grid; use functional regions and ruled rows.
Don't use excessive gradients or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't anthropomorphize agents or imply capabilities that the backend has not reported.
Don't hide automation, fallback behavior, tool calls, evidence state, or access scope.
